g.text: Dev evaluation of final model (mean of 3 seeds)
Train curve: mean loss over each 10-step window, dropout on, bf16, on seen pairs, shared random negatives (K = 257).
Diamonds: eval mode, fp32, held-out dev queries, 100k pool. Same K and formula but different mode, data and averaging → no overfitting claim.
